overview.zh: Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: polished explanatory presentation slide image for a technical blog about HiRoute. Style: beautifully typeset professional PPT, flat vector-like precision, restrained indigo/periwinkle with teal accents on a pale off-white background, dark navy type, crisp generously spaced rounded panels and clean arrows. Landscape 16:9. No abstract 3D scene, no fake product screenshot, no charts or invented numbers, no robots, no unrelated logos. Prioritize large readable text and visual explanation over decoration. All supplied text must be rendered exactly, clearly and without extra text. This depicts product roles and configuration options, not automatic task decomposition or guaranteed success. Label the arrow from Agent to HiRoute "执行中的模型调用". A feedback strip beneath the main flow shows "执行事实" → "阶段评估" → "后续选择"; connect that last label back to the HiRoute panel with one clearly directed feedback arrow. Bottom row contains three equal elegant cards: "更省" / "把强推理用在关键工作"; "更稳" / "阶段内保持稳定，交接点再判断"; "更懂" / "结合执行表现评估胜任度". Small footer: "让合适的 Agent 接住任务，让合适的模型完成每一步。". competence.zh: Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: beautiful explanatory PPT-style slide for HiRoute's technical article. Landscape 16:9, large exceptionally legible text, white/off-white background, dark navy headings, indigo and teal rounded panels, restrained orange only for the cost-risk strip, clean thin arrows. Flat professional presentation design with simple icons; no abstract art, no fake application interface, no invented measurements, no unrelated logos. Render the specified text exactly, no extra labels. Simplified Chinese only except the brand HiRoute. Title: "省钱，先看是否胜任". Subtitle: "复杂度决定机会，胜任度约束冒险". Upper row: two equal input panels. Left heading "任务复杂度", text "接下来需要什么能力？", small caption "明确工作 / 复杂推理". Right heading "阶段胜任度", text "刚才实际做得怎么样？", small caption "有效进展 · 工具活动 · 失败与恢复". Both panels have arrows into a centered decision node below: "HiRoute 在交接点重新判断". From this node, two clearly separate arrows lead to: teal panel "工作适合，表现足够" with text "继续考虑经济模型"; indigo panel "胜任度低于配置下限" with text "交给主力模型接续". Across the bottom, a distinct slim light-orange risk strip headed "只盯单价，可能付出更多" shows "反复试错" → "错误上下文累积" → "主力模型返工". Footer: "阶段评分基于可见历史，不等于成功率；最终交付仍需独立验收。". Clear one-slide teaching graphic, readable at blog width, no overcrowding.

Upper row: two equal input panels. Left heading "Task complexity", text "What capability does the next step need?", small caption "Explicit work / Complex reasoning". Right heading "Stage competence", text "How well did the model actually perform?", small caption "Progress · Tool activity · Failures and recovery". Both panels have arrows into a centered decision node below: "HiRoute reassesses at a handoff". Across the bottom, a distinct slim light-orange risk strip headed "A lower unit price can still cost more" shows "Repeated mistakes" → "Accumulated faulty context" → "Rework by the stronger model". Footer: "Stage assessment uses visible history, not a success probability. Verify the final delivery independently.". Clear one-slide teaching graphic, readable at blog width, no overcrowding.
